companies.name: Fluidstack
companies.summary_ko: 영국 런던 기반의 비상장 GPU 클라우드 기업. Cipher Barber Lake 의 입주사.
companies.summary_en: Private London-based GPU cloud provider; tenant at Cipher's Barber Lake.

companies.name: Google
companies.summary_ko: 알파벳 자회사. 일부 AI 데이터센터 임대 계약에 보증인으로 참여한다.
companies.summary_en: Alphabet subsidiary; acts as lease backstop on some AI data center contracts.

companies.name: Amazon Web Services
companies.summary_ko: 아마존의 클라우드 사업부. Cipher Black Pearl·Stingray 의 입주사.
companies.summary_en: Amazon's cloud division; tenant at Cipher's Black Pearl and Stingray.

companies.name: Galaxy Digital
companies.summary_ko: 뉴욕 본사의 디지털자산·데이터센터 기업. 텍사스 Helios 비트코인 채굴장을 AI/HPC 데이터센터로 전환해 CoreWeave에 526MW(IT)를 15년 임대했으며, 텍사스 전역에서 5.7GW 규모의 전력 파이프라인을 추진 중이다.
companies.summary_en: New York-based digital asset and data center company. Converted its Helios bitcoin mine in Texas into an AI/HPC campus leasing 526MW of critical IT to CoreWeave for 15 years, with a 5.7GW Texas power pipeline.

metrics.label_en: Expected avg. annual CoreWeave lease revenue

companies.name: Cipher Digital
companies.summary_ko: 뉴욕 본사(2026-02 Cipher Mining에서 사명 변경). 비트코인 채굴에서 하이퍼스케일 HPC 데이터센터 임대로 전환해 Fluidstack(Google 보증)·AWS와 서부 텍사스 3개 캠퍼스(총 700MW gross) 장기 임대 계약을 맺었다.
companies.summary_en: New York-based (renamed from Cipher Mining in Feb 2026). Pivoted from bitcoin mining to hyperscale HPC leasing, with long-term leases to Fluidstack (Google-backstopped) and AWS across three West Texas campuses (700MW gross).

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.summary_ko: 미국 AI 연구 기업(Claude 개발사). 일부 데이터센터의 최종 사용자·장기 임차인.
companies.summary_en: US AI lab (maker of Claude); end user / long-term tenant at some data centers.

companies.name: AMD
companies.summary_ko: 미국 반도체 기업. Core Scientific 일부 사이트의 직접 임차인 또는 신용보강 제공자.
companies.summary_en: US chipmaker; direct tenant or credit support at some Core Scientific sites.

companies.name: Core42
companies.summary_ko: UAE G42 계열 AI 클라우드 기업. TeraWulf Lake Mariner 의 임차인.
companies.summary_en: UAE G42-affiliated AI cloud company; tenant at TeraWulf Lake Mariner.

companies.name: Chirisa Technology Parks
companies.summary_ko: 미국 데이터센터 개발사. CoreWeave Lancaster·Richmond 캠퍼스 개발에 참여.
companies.summary_en: US data center developer; co-developer of CoreWeave's Lancaster and Richmond campuses.

companies.name: Machine Investment Group
companies.summary_ko: 미국 디지털 인프라 개발·투자사. CoreWeave Lancaster 공동 개발.
companies.summary_en: US digital infrastructure developer/investor; co-developer of CoreWeave Lancaster.

companies.name: Blue Owl Capital
companies.summary_ko: 미국 대체투자 운용사. AI 데이터센터 개발·장비 금융 제공.
companies.summary_en: US alternative asset manager; finances AI data center development and equipment.

companies.name: IREN
companies.summary_ko: 호주 시드니 본사. 비트코인 채굴에서 AI 클라우드로 전환 중이며 Microsoft·NVIDIA 등과 GPU 클라우드 계약을 맺었다.
companies.summary_en: Sydney-based. Transitioning from bitcoin mining to AI cloud with GPU contracts from Microsoft, NVIDIA and others.

companies.name: CoreWeave
companies.summary_ko: 뉴저지 리빙스턴 본사의 AI 전용 GPU 클라우드 기업(네오클라우드). 2026년 6월 말 활성 전력 1.5GW·계약 전력 약 3.7GW·수주잔고 약 1,040억 달러이며, 데이터센터는 대부분 채굴사·개발사 캠퍼스에 임차 입주하고 뉴저지 Kenilworth(지분 35% JV)에서 첫 자체 개발을 진행 중이다.
companies.summary_en: Livingston, NJ-based AI GPU cloud (neocloud) with 1.5GW active power, ~3.7GW contracted power and ~$104bn revenue backlog at end-June 2026. It mostly leases capacity at miner and developer campuses, and is developing its first own facility in Kenilworth, NJ via a 35%-owned JV.

companies.name: Hut 8 Corp.
companies.summary_ko: 마이애미 본사의 에너지 인프라 플랫폼(채굴은 자회사 American Bitcoin이 담당). 전력 선확보 모델로 루이지애나 River Bend(Fluidstack·Anthropic, Google 보증 245MW IT)와 텍사스 Beacon Point(익명 AA- 이상 테넌트 704MW IT) 두 AI 캠퍼스를 개발 중이며, 계약 IT 용량 949MW·기본 계약가치 약 $26.6bn.
companies.summary_en: Miami-based energy infrastructure platform (bitcoin mining sits in majority-owned American Bitcoin). Using a power-first model it is building two AI campuses: River Bend, LA (245MW IT for Fluidstack/Anthropic, Google-backstopped) and Beacon Point, TX (704MW IT for an undisclosed AA-or-better tenant): 949MW IT contracted, ~$26.6bn base-term value.

metrics.label_ko: 건설중 전력 용량(River Bend 330 + Beacon Point 1,000)
metrics.label_en: Energy capacity under construction (River Bend 330 + Beacon Point 1,000)

metrics.label_ko: 투자등급 프로젝트 파이낸싱(River Bend 3.25 + Beacon Point 4.25)
metrics.label_en: Investment-grade project financing (River Bend 3.25 + Beacon Point 4.25)

companies.name: Core Scientific
companies.summary_ko: 비트코인 채굴사에서 AI용 고밀도 코로케이션(HDC) 사업자로 전환한 미국 기업. CoreWeave와 5개 사이트 약 590MW(IT) 12년 계약, 2026년 7월 AMD·네오클라우드와 약 530MW 15년 계약을 맺었다. 2025년 7월 CoreWeave의 약 90억달러 전액 주식 인수 합의는 2025-10-30 주주총회 부결로 무산돼 독립 상장사로 남았다.
companies.summary_en: US bitcoin miner turned high-density colocation (HDC) provider for AI. Leases ~590MW of critical IT to CoreWeave across five sites (12-year terms) and signed ~530MW of 15-year leases with AMD and a neocloud in July 2026. CoreWeave's ~$9bn all-stock takeover agreed in July 2025 failed the Oct 30, 2025 shareholder vote and was terminated; the company remains independent.

companies.name: TeraWulf
companies.summary_ko: 메릴랜드 이스턴 본사. 뉴욕 Lake Mariner 비트코인 채굴장을 AI/HPC 임대 캠퍼스로 전환해 Core42·Fluidstack(Google 보증)에 438MW(IT)를 임대 중이며, 켄터키 Justified 캠퍼스에서 Anthropic과 401MW(IT) 20년 임대 계약을 맺었다.
companies.summary_en: Easton, Maryland-based. Converting its Lake Mariner (NY) bitcoin mine into an AI/HPC leasing campus with 438MW of critical IT leased to Core42 and Fluidstack (Google-backstopped), plus a 20-year, 401MW (IT) Anthropic lease at its Justified campus in Kentucky.

metrics.label_ko: 가동 중 HPC 용량(IT, 매출 발생)

companies.name: Lancium
companies.summary_ko: 전력·부지 개발사. Abilene·Childress 부지 개발.
companies.summary_en: Power and land developer behind the Abilene and Childress sites.

companies.name: Primary Digital Infrastructure
companies.summary_ko: 디지털 인프라 투자사. Abilene 합작 소유.
companies.summary_en: Digital-infrastructure investor; co-owner of the Abilene JV.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.summary_ko: Abilene 건설 대출 주간사.
companies.summary_en: Lead arranger of the Abilene construction loans.

companies.name: DataOne
companies.summary_ko: 데이터센터 개발사. Nebius 바인랜드 개발·소유.
companies.summary_en: Data-center developer; builds and owns Nebius Vineland.

companies.name: Polarnode
companies.summary_ko: 핀란드 데이터센터 개발사. Nebius 라펜란타 개발.
companies.summary_en: Finnish data-center developer behind Nebius Lappeenranta.

companies.name: Crusoe
companies.summary_ko: 덴버 기반 비상장 AI 인프라 기업(옛 Crusoe Energy). 전력 확보부터 데이터센터 건설·운영, 클라우드(Crusoe Cloud)까지 수직 통합. Lancium 부지의 Abilene 캠퍼스(1.2GW, Oracle 임차·OpenAI Stargate 1호)를 지었고, 그 옆에 Microsoft용 900MW 캠퍼스, 텍사스 Armstrong County(Google)·Childress(Lancium), 미주리 Warrenton 캠퍼스를 개발 중이다.
companies.summary_en: Denver-based private AI infrastructure company (formerly Crusoe Energy), vertically integrated from power sourcing to data center construction, operation and cloud. Built the 1.2GW Abilene campus on Lancium's site (leased to Oracle, OpenAI's flagship Stargate), and is developing an adjacent 900MW campus for Microsoft plus campuses in Armstrong County TX (Google), Childress TX (with Lancium) and Warrenton MO.

companies.name: Nebius Group N.V.
companies.summary_ko: 암스테르담 본사의 풀스택 AI 클라우드(네오클라우드) 기업(옛 Yandex N.V.). 핀란드 맨쨀래 자체 데이터센터(75MW)와 Microsoft 전용 뉴저지 바인랜드 build-to-suit 캠퍼스(최대 300MW)를 운영하고, 미주리 인디펜던스·펜실베이니아 하이리지(각 최대 1.2GW)·앨라배마 버밍엄·핀란드 라펜란타 등 자체 AI 팩토리를 건설 중이며 2026년 말 계약 전력 5GW를 목표로 한다.
companies.summary_en: Amsterdam-based full-stack AI cloud (neocloud), formerly Yandex N.V. Operates its owned Mäntsälä, Finland data center (75MW) and the Microsoft-dedicated Vineland, NJ build-to-suit campus (up to 300MW), and is building owned AI factories in Independence, MO and Highridge, PA (up to 1.2GW each), Birmingham, AL and Lappeenranta, Finland; targets 5GW contracted power by end-2026.

metrics.label_en: Contracted power (secured land and power commitments, 'exceeds 3.5 GW')

Second Meta agreement (up to, 5 years, starting early 2027)

colocations.note_en: Former Bridgestone plant; Azur funds construction, Nebius operates. ~120MW targeted by end-2026

colocations.note_en: London plus three more, 65MW total by 2027

companies.summary_en: Data-center developer; builds and owns Oracle Stargate Shackelford and Port Washington.

companies.name: Related Digital
companies.summary_ko: 데이터센터 개발사. Oracle Stargate Saline Township 개발.
companies.summary_en: Data-center developer behind Oracle Stargate in Saline Township.

companies.name: Blackstone
companies.summary_ko: 자산운용사. Saline Township 캠퍼스 지분 투자.
companies.summary_en: Asset manager; equity investor in the Saline Township campus.

companies.name: STACK Infrastructure
companies.summary_ko: 데이터센터 개발사(Blue Owl 계열). Project Jupiter 개발.
companies.summary_en: Data-center developer (Blue Owl affiliate) on Project Jupiter.

companies.name: BorderPlex Digital Assets
companies.summary_ko: 개발사. Project Jupiter(도냐아나 카운티) 공동 개발.
companies.summary_en: Co-developer of Project Jupiter in Doña Ana County.

companies.name: BlackRock
companies.summary_ko: 자산운용사. Meta 엘패소 합작 80% 소유(GIP·HPS 포함).
companies.summary_en: Asset manager; 80% owner of the Meta El Paso JV (incl. GIP, HPS).

companies.name: Oracle
companies.summary_ko: 텍사스 오스틴 본사의 데이터베이스·클라우드 기업. OCI 로 OpenAI 등에 AI 인프라를 공급하며, Vantage·Related Digital·STACK 같은 개발사가 짓는 Stargate 캠퍼스(Shackelford·Saline Township·Port Washington·Doña Ana)를 장기 임차해 직접 운영한다. 2026-08 말 RPO 6,640억 달러, 분기 IaaS 매출 74억 달러.
companies.summary_en: Austin-based database and cloud company. Through OCI it supplies AI infrastructure to OpenAI and others, leasing and operating Stargate campuses built by developers such as Vantage, Related Digital and STACK (Shackelford, Saline Township, Port Washington, Doña Ana). RPO of $664bn and quarterly IaaS revenue of $7.4bn as of Aug 2026.

metrics.label_en: Power and data center capacity secured through partners (online over next 3 years, 'more than 10 GW')

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.summary_ko: Azure·Copilot 운영사(워싱턴주 레드먼드). AI 전용 자체 캠퍼스로 위스콘신 Mount Pleasant 의 "Fairwater"(1단계 2026-06 완전 가동, 2단계 2028 완공 목표, 북쪽 15개 동 추가 승인)를 짓고 있으며, Fairwater Atlanta(QTS 소유 건물 임차)와 Nebius·IREN·Nscale·Lambda·CoreWeave·Crusoe 등 외부 용량을 함께 확보한다. FY2026 설비투자(현금) $115.9bn, 아직 개시 전인 데이터센터 위주 임대 약정 $329.1bn.
companies.summary_en: Redmond-based operator of Azure and Copilot. Its own AI-dedicated campus is "Fairwater" in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin (phase 1 fully operational June 2026, phase 2 due 2028, 15 more buildings approved to the north); it also uses Fairwater Atlanta (QTS-owned buildings, leased) and third-party capacity from Nebius, IREN, Nscale, Lambda, CoreWeave and Crusoe. FY2026 cash capex was $115.9bn, with $329.1bn of mostly datacenter leases not yet commenced.

metrics.label_en: Leases not yet commenced (mostly datacenters, FY27–33)

metrics.label_en: Azure & other cloud services revenue growth (FY2026)

colocations.name: Fairwater Atlanta (QTS Fayetteville campus)
colocations.note_ko: Microsoft 두 번째 Fairwater(2025-10 가동, GB200 NVL72, 2층 구조). 부지·건물은 QTS 소유, Microsoft 임차. MW 미공개(제3자 추정 FW1 약 340MW IT).
colocations.note_en: Microsoft's second Fairwater (live Oct 2025, GB200 NVL72, two-story). Land and buildings owned by QTS and leased to Microsoft. MW undisclosed (third-party est. ~340MW IT for FW1).

companies.name: Meta Platforms
companies.summary_ko: Facebook·Instagram·WhatsApp 운영사. 'Meta Compute' 로 자체 AI 클러스터를 짓고 있으며, 오하이오 뉴올버니의 Prometheus(1GW+, 2026 가동 목표)와 루이지애나 리치랜드 패리시의 Hyperion(5GW, Blue Owl 80% 합작) 이 대표 캠퍼스다. 엘패소(1GW, BlackRock 80% 합작)·앨버타 스터전(1GW)도 건설 중이며, 2026 설비투자 가이던스는 1,300억~1,450억 달러.
companies.summary_en: Parent of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, building its own AI clusters under 'Meta Compute': Prometheus in New Albany, Ohio (1GW+, targeted online in 2026) and Hyperion in Richland Parish, Louisiana (5GW, 80% owned by Blue Owl funds) lead the fleet, with 1GW campuses under construction in El Paso (80% BlackRock JV) and Sturgeon County, Alberta. 2026 capex guidance is $130–145bn.

metrics.label_en: 2026 capex guidance, low end ($130–145bn range as of Jul 2026)

metrics.label_en: Leases not yet commenced (data centers, colocations etc., commencing 2026–2036)

metrics.label_en: Non-cancelable contractual commitments (mostly third-party cloud capacity, servers etc.)

colocations.name: Sandersville, Georgia (CleanSpark build-to-suit lease)
colocations.note_ko: 임차인은 Meta 자회사 Anviran LLC, Meta 가 임대료 보증. IT 175MW, 20년 기본 임대(약 66억 달러), 1단계 임대 개시 2027 Q4 목표. 건설 상태는 CleanSpark '개발 중' 표현 기준.
colocations.note_en: Tenant is Meta subsidiary Anviran LLC with Meta guaranteeing rent; 175MW critical IT, 20-year base term (~$6.6bn), phase I rent commencement targeted Q4 2027. Status per CleanSpark's 'developing' wording.

colocations.name: Jamnagar, Gujarat (Reliance build-to-suit lease)
colocations.note_ko: Meta 의 인도 첫 'AI 지원' 데이터센터. Reliance 가 168MW 를 짓고 Meta 가 임차(확장 옵션). 2026-06 발표.
colocations.note_en: Meta's first 'AI-enabled' data center in India: Reliance builds 168MW, leased by Meta with options to scale (announced Jun 2026).

companies.name: SK Telecom
companies.summary_ko: 한국 1위 이동통신사로, 자회사 SK브로드밴드(2027년 1분기 'SK호라이즌'으로 분할 예정)를 통해 데이터센터 8곳(합계 약 137MW)을 운영하고 AWS와 울산 미포국가산단에 103MW AI 데이터센터를 짓고 있다. 2026-07 AI DC 개발 전문회사 'SK하이퍼'를 세워 2029년 5GW·2035년 15GW를 목표로 제시했으나, 울산·구로 외 GW급 사업은 부지·일정 미확정.
companies.summary_en: Korea's largest mobile carrier. Through subsidiary SK Broadband (DC unit to be spun off as 'SK Horizon' in Q1 2027) it runs eight data centers (~137MW) and is building a 103MW AI data center with AWS in Ulsan's Mipo industrial complex. Its new developer arm 'SK Hyper' (Jul 2026) targets 5GW by 2029 and 15GW by 2035, but beyond Ulsan and Guro no GW-scale site or schedule is fixed.

metrics.label_en: SK Horizon DC capacity target (8 existing + Ulsan, Guro)
External equity raised for SK Horizon (KKR 29%, IMM consortium 20%)

companies.name: NAVER
companies.summary_ko: 한국 최대 인터넷 플랫폼 기업. 자체 데이터센터 '각 춘천'(2013, 약 40MW)과 '각 세종'(2023, 현재 수전 47MW·설계 최대 270MW)을 운영하며, 2026-07 엔비디아(10억달러 지분 투자)·브룩필드(최대 90억달러, 최종 계약 전)와 함께 각 세종에 200MW AI 팩토리(2027 상반기 55MW → 2028년 200MW)를 짓겠다고 발표했다. 수도권에서는 LG CNS·다우기술 데이터센터를 장기 임차한다.
companies.summary_en: Korea's largest internet platform. It runs its own data centers GAK Chuncheon (2013, ~40MW) and GAK Sejong (2023; 47MW grid intake today, designed for up to 270MW). In Jul 2026 it announced, with NVIDIA ($1bn equity investment) and Brookfield (up to $9bn, final agreement pending), a 200MW AI factory at GAK Sejong (55MW in H1 2027, 200MW by 2028). In the Seoul area it leases space in LG CNS and Daou Technology data centers.

companies.summary_ko: 도쿄 본사의 투자 지주회사로 OpenAI 의 최대 외부 투자자 중 하나다. 지배 자회사 SB Energy 를 통해 텍사스 Milam County(OpenAI 임차, IT 753MW)·오하이오 PORTS-Pike(OpenAI 임차, IT 8.0GW)·오스틴 Cosmos(소프트뱅크 계열 임차, IT 50MW) 데이터센터 캠퍼스를 개발·소유하고, 오하이오 Lordstown 옛 GM 공장을 Stargate 장비 제조·데이터센터 거점으로 바꾸고 있다. 2026-09 기준 가동 중인 데이터센터 용량은 없다.
companies.summary_en: Tokyo-based investment holding company and one of OpenAI's largest outside investors. Through its controlled subsidiary SB Energy it develops and owns data center campuses in Milam County, TX (leased to OpenAI, 753MW IT), PORTS-Pike, OH (leased to OpenAI, 8.0GW IT) and Cosmos in Austin (leased to a SoftBank affiliate, 50MW IT), and is converting the former GM Lordstown plant in Ohio into a Stargate equipment-manufacturing and data center site. No data center capacity was in operation as of Sep 2026.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.summary_ko: 샌프란시스코의 AI 연구·서비스 기업(ChatGPT·Codex). 컴퓨팅 대부분을 Oracle·Microsoft·CoreWeave·SB Energy 등 다른 회사 시설에서 조달하고(해당 사이트의 tenant·end_user 로 표시), 직접 설계·개발하는 첫 캠퍼스는 조지아주 Effingham County 의 Project Camellia(3.2GW, 2028~2032 단계 공급)다. 2025년 컴퓨팅 약 1.9GW, 연환산 매출 200억 달러 이상.
companies.summary_en: San Francisco AI lab and service provider (ChatGPT, Codex). Most of its compute comes from facilities owned by others such as Oracle, Microsoft, CoreWeave and SB Energy (shown as tenant/end user at those sites); its first self-designed and self-developed campus is Project Camellia in Effingham County, Georgia (3.2GW, phased 2028–2032). Compute of ~1.9GW and $20bn+ ARR in 2025.
